units.source_text: 他又反复投了好几次，距离也好，方向也好，都相当稳定了。

en.t: He threw it several more times, and both the distance and the direction had become fairly steady.

units.source_text: 虽说如此，但离命中目标似乎还相差得很远。

en.t: Even so, he still seemed a long way from hitting the target.

units.source_text: 要是能看出些许长进的样子，那倒还可以轻松几分，然而，一点不见减少误差的动静，

en.t: If he could have seen even the slightest sign of improvement, he might have felt a little easier, but there was no sign at all that the error was narrowing,

units.source_text: 疲劳、焦急，反而使得他更容易出错。

en.t: and fatigue and impatience only made him more likely to make mistakes.

units.source_text: 看来是把问题想得太简单了。

en.t: It seemed he had thought the problem was far too simple.

units.source_text: 尽管没被谁欺骗，但他却特别生气，差一点没哭出来。

en.t: Although no one had deceived him, he was terribly angry and almost burst into tears.
